item.title: Hull joins nationwide movement by signing Local Music Action Charter
item.description: Hull has signed the UK Music Local Music Action Charter, strengthening its commitment to supporting local talent, boosting the music ecosystem, and delivering cultural growth.

item.title: Peach Hampers wins retail innovators award at 2025 family business awards
item.description: Peach Hampers has won the Retail Innovators Award at the 2025 Yorkshire & Humberside Family Business Awards, recognising their creativity and personalised gifting.

item.title: Dynamic duo explore Hull’s Maritime Museum in latest edition of Maritime Tales comic
item.description: The new Maritime Tales comic explores Hull’s Maritime Museum as Lily and Jacob go behind the scenes during its major transformation. Available now online and in print.

item.title: Replica Kenneth Carter panel recreated for Queen’s Gardens
item.description: A newly recreated Kenneth Carter stone panel has been installed in Queen’s Gardens, restoring a missing piece of the 1961 artwork series as part of the garden’s refurbishment.

item.title: Hull community project launches Christmas support initiative for vulnerable people
item.description: A new Hull community project is offering free health checks and collecting winter donations to support vulnerable people this Christmas. Find out how to get involved.

item.description: Poorboy Boutique’s massive warehouse on Bontoft Avenue is packed full of vintage clothes from coats and jackets to jeans, boots, and loads more – and on Saturday 6th Dec from 10am to 4pm, you can dive in. item.title: Neurodiverse and Care Experienced Christmas Exhibition at the Guildhall
item.description: Hull’s Neurodiverse and Care Experienced Christmas Exhibition returns to the Guildhall on 12 December, celebrating young entrepreneurs with festive gifts, crafts and support.
